name: Onna Senshi Yui ~Kairaku ni Ochiru Yoru~
original_name: 女戦士ユイ 快楽に堕ちる夜
source:
Yui undertook an assignment as a transporter. However, the boulevard that leads to the destination was blocked. With the five remaining days until the due date, Yui had to find a solution to get there...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075098.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
由依接受了运输员的任务。然而，通往目的地的大道被封锁了。距离预产期还剩五天，唯必须找到解决办法才能到达预产期……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075098.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
